gif-bg-remover.title: GIF Background Remover
gif-bg-remover.description: Cut the background out of an animated GIF: temporal background modelling, colour keying and edge refinement — all local, export a transparent GIF or a PNG sequence.
gif-bg-remover.drop-subtitle: Works best when the background is static or a flat colour
gif-bg-remover.paste-hint: You can also paste a GIF from the clipboard
gif-bg-remover.note-png: Packed {{n}} PNG frames with real alpha
gif-bg-remover.output-tip: GIF transparency is 1-bit — there is no semi-transparent pixel, so soft edges must be faked with a matte colour or dithering.
gif-bg-remover.matte-color-tip: The four swatches on the left cover the colours stickers and emoji usually land on; the picker on the right is for anything else.
gif-bg-remover.dither-tip: Only alpha diffuses. The Floyd–Steinberg noise pattern shifts every frame and can crawl in an animation.
gif-bg-remover.size-hint: No inter-frame delta yet — the real file is usually below {{size}}
gif-bg-remover.engine-tip: Auto finds the still background from the per-pixel temporal median. It fails when the subject never moves — switch to keying or the brush.
gif-bg-remover.connected-tip: When on, only the region connected to a seed counts as background, so same-coloured patches inside the subject survive.
gif-bg-remover.combine-max: Keep only if both say foreground
gif-bg-remover.combine-tip: min is aggressive, max is conservative.
gif-bg-remover.seeds-hint: {{n}} colours sampled, the last 8 are kept
gif-bg-remover.no-seeds: Click the preview to sample a colour
gif-bg-remover.temporal-tip: Median of neighbouring frames' alpha to kill flicker; applies only when exporting the whole sequence.
gif-bg-remover.guided-tip: Constrains the feather with the image structure so soft edges follow real contours.
gif-bg-remover.decontaminate-tip: Solves I = αF + (1−α)B back to the foreground colour to clear background mixed into soft edges.
gif-bg-remover.error-load: This GIF could not be read
gif-bg-remover.error-export: Export failed — lower the colour count or the size and retry
gif-bg-remover.notice-short-sequence: Too few frames for temporal background modelling; switched to colour keying
gif-bg-remover.notice-no-model: No temporal background model available — use the picker or the brush
